comparisonNotes: Machine-readable baseline for the resolved prefill row width decision.
Chosen resolved row count: 32. It is the balance point across both fixtures rather than a single-width speed winner.

For the wider-hidden Llama fixture, 32 rows beats 16 at every measured window and captures most of the gain from raising to 64. For Qwen, 16/32/64 are within measurement noise except that 64 is slightly worse at 1024.
These runs use --reps 1 (warm plus best-of-one) because each candidate width reopens a real model engine across three long windows.
